title: Convexity of the Euclidean norm under expectation
statement: For every dimension $n$ and real-valued functions $u,v$ on the Boolean cube $\\{0,1\}^n$, the Euclidean norm of their expectations is at most the expectation of their pointwise Euclidean norm: $\sqrt{(\E[u])^2+(\E[v])^2}\le\E[\sqrt{u^2+v^2}]$.
replaced: For any real functions $u,v$ on a uniform Boolean cube, $\sqrt{(\mathbb E u)^2+(\mathbb E v)^2}\le\mathbb E\sqrt{u^2+v^2}$.
